definition: said to agree, often not happily
description: A frozen lake in winter at sunrise, with snowy pine trees and a small red wooden sauna cabin. A young woman in a swimsuit sits in a square hole cut in the ice, laughing and waving him in. A young man kneeling on the snow pulls his dark red hoodie off over his head and drops it, raises his hands with a resigned grin, his bare chest in the cold air, and starts to get up to join her. A husky stands by the cabin, and a pair of boots stands in the snow.

taps.phrase: to wave from the icy water

de.answer: Sie winkt aus dem eisigen Wasser.
